:::{#def-npv}
#### Negative predictive value (NPV)

The **negative predictive value**
[@wikipedia_positive_and_negative_predictive_values] of a diagnostic test is the probability
that the person tested does not have the disease ($\neg D$),
given that the test is negative ($\neg +$):

$$\text{NPV} \eqdef \Pr(\neg D \mid \neg +)$$ {#eq-npv}

:::
